discription: A bright lead sound using a square wave with a resonant low-pass filter and a classic ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=4000, rq=0.2; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.05, 0.2, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, 0.5); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
